name: Tenebris
source:
Tenebris is an enigmatic super mutant with the power to manipulate shadows, summoning spectral creatures to fight by her side or vanishing into the deepest darkness to confuse and destroy her enemies. No concrete information is known about her goals, but her ability to hide in the shadows makes her virtually impossible to locate. It is said that, like an evil presence in the darkness, she is always ready to strike when you least expect it.

[In game description]
